Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: User voice, suggestions, and feedback visible strictly to the sender and administrators.

authorId.description: The UID of the user who submitted the feedback.

authorPhotoUrl.description: Avatar photo URL of the author.

title.description: Brief headline or summary of the feedback.

content.description: Detailed text content of the feedback or inquiry.

targetModule.description: Which platform module or topic the submission relates to.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the submission managed by admin.

adminNote.description: Optional response note or status explanation provided by administrator.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the submission was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the submission was last updated.

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.description: Designated administrator identity record granting elevated review privileges.

addedAt.description: Server timestamp when admin role was conferred.

/feedbacks/{feedbackId}.description: Private feedback submissions viewable solely by the sender and verified administrators.

/admins/{adminUid}.description: Protected admin collection for role authorization lookups.
